question: 2025 సెప్టెంబరులో, ఆసియా క్రికెట్ కౌన్సిల్ అధ్యక్షుడు మరియు __________ కి చెందిన అంతర్గత మంత్రి నుండి ఆసియా కప్ ట్రోఫీని స్వీకరించడానికి భారత క్రికెట్ జట్టు నిరాకరించింది.
solution:
The correct answer is __**పాకిస్తాన్**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jay Shah**, the current **President** of the **Asian Cricket Council (ACC)** and the **Secretary** of the **BCCI**, plays a leading role in the administration of the **Asia Cup**.
 
• **Mohsin Naqvi** holds a prominent dual role as the **Interior Minister** of **Pakistan** and the **Chairman** of the **Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB)**, having been appointed in **2024**.
 
• The **Asia Cup 2025** is scheduled to be hosted by **India** and will be played in the **Twenty20 (T20)** format, serving as a precursor to global T20 events.
 
• The refusal of the **Indian Cricket Team** to engage in ceremonial exchanges with a high-ranking political official from **Pakistan** is rooted in the long-standing diplomatic and security policies of the **Government of India**.
 
• Relations between the two cricket boards are often dictated by geopolitical tensions, leading to a policy where **India** avoids bilateral cricket and limits interactions to mandatory **ICC** or **ACC** tournament frameworks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Cricket Council (ACC)**:
 
 
• The **ACC** was formed in **September 1983** to promote cricket in the Asian continent.
 
• Its headquarters are located in **Colombo, Sri Lanka**, and it currently comprises **25 member associations**.
 
• The **Asia Cup** is its flagship event, alternating between **ODI** and **T20** formats depending on the upcoming World Cup schedule.
 
 
 
• **Mohsin Naqvi and Pakistan Cricket**:
 
 
• **Mohsin Naqvi** was appointed as the **Interior Minister** of **Pakistan** in **March 2024** while simultaneously leading the **PCB**.
 
• His tenure has been marked by efforts to upgrade stadiums in **Lahore**, **Karachi**, and **Rawalpindi** ahead of major international tournaments like the **Champions Trophy 2025**.
 
 
 
• **India-Pakistan Cricket Standoff**:
 
 
• Due to political reasons, the two nations have not played a bilateral series since **2012-13**, when **Pakistan** toured **India** for a short limited-overs series.
 
• The **BCCI** (Board of Control for Cricket in India) requires explicit permission from the **Ministry of External Affairs** to participate in any event involving **Pakistan**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Hybrid Model**: In the **2023 Asia Cup**, a unique **"Hybrid Model"** was implemented because **India** refused to travel to **Pakistan**. **Pakistan** hosted **4 matches**, while **9 matches**, including the final, were held in **Sri Lanka**.
 
• **Champions Trophy 2025**: **Pakistan** holds the hosting rights for the **2025 ICC Champions Trophy**, which has led to intense debate regarding **India's** travel plans and the potential for a neutral venue or another hybrid arrangement.
 
• **Diplomatic Protocol**: In international sports, receiving awards or trophies from political heads of nations with active diplomatic disputes is a sensitive matter, often resulting in teams following strict government-mandated protocols to avoid political signaling.
